# Gaussian Renderer Provenance

These files are copied unchanged from the user's validated local integration:
`/home/cgz/3dgs/gazebo-k2-automation-20261022/renderer` and `shaders`.
That integration adapted RVizSplat (`suchetanrs`, upstream revision recorded in
the original technical report as `a1b476670c05b404ed8889ac4be7781134517925`).
Local adaptations retain float32 covariance and portable DC colors and support
Gazebo Classic / Ogre 1.9. The actual bundled `renderer/LICENSE` is MIT and is
preserved verbatim. Shader provenance comments are preserved as supplied.
The input scans, Gaussians, binaries and reports are not included here.
